description: This file defines a Java class `PublicJsonExamplesProducer` that generates Markdown-formatted JSON example snippets for documentation purposes. It produces example JSON representations of Ditto Protocol messages wrapped in Markdown code blocks, intended for use in documentation files such as Markdown (.md) files. The class includes methods to create different snippets based on various inputs, handling exceptions and integrating with external classes for JSON manipulation and protocol adaptation.

classes.name: PublicJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates Markdown-formatted JSON examples for Ditto protocol messages, primarily used for documentation purposes. It handles JSON serialization, exception wrapping, and protocol adaptation, producing snippets with configurable formatting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to generate Markdown JSON examples based on provided target folder path and format type.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON snippet, formats it as Markdown, and writes to specified file location.

methods.name: wrapExceptionInErrorResponse
methods.description: Wraps a JSONifiable object in an appropriate error response if it is an exception related to Ditto protocol.

methods.name: findMatchingToAdaptableMethod
methods.description: Finds a method in the protocol adapter that can convert a specific class into an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Jsonifiable object to an Adaptable using reflection-based method invocation.
